name: vidIQ
description:
vidIQ gives Claude access to creator intelligence and content workflows across YouTube, Instagram, and TikTok. Research YouTube keywords, trends, outlier videos, channels, competitors, transcripts, comments, and performance data. Analyze connected channels with YouTube Analytics, generate titles, scripts, clips, and comment-reply drafts, find stock B-roll, compose and edit media, render motion graphics, and manage competitor watchlists. Discover public Instagram profiles and reels, and search Instagram and TikTok outlier content and creators.

Data for Instagram and TikTok comes from a mix of third-party sources and vidIQ’s own first-party collection. Instagram data is not sourced through Meta’s official API.

_published_faq.name: How do I add vidIQ to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add vidIQ to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.vidiq.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

acceptedAnswer.text: As of September 16, 2026, vidIQ scores 0/100 on Manufact's MCP publishing checklist. The scan does not yet meet ChatGPT publishing checks and does not yet meet Claude publishing checks. Passing these checks does not guarantee marketplace approval.

acceptedAnswer.text: vidIQ lists 43 MCP tools, including vidiq_keyword_research, vidiq_outliers, vidiq_similar_thumbnails, vidiq_channel_stats, vidiq_trending_videos, vidiq_channel_search, vidiq_video_earnings_estimate, vidiq_earnings_calculate, vidiq_video_stats, vidiq_get_videos_by_ids, vidiq_youtube_search, and vidiq_get_channels_by_ids.
